# T-1: Extract step-tree utilities

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Move steps-array-only utilities out of definition.js into a dedicated step-tree module.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The new step-tree module exports flattenSteps, findStepById, findFirstPendingLeaf, findInProgressLeaf, and related steps-array-only helpers.
- definition.js no longer owns helpers that operate only on flow.json steps arrays.
- Current production and test imports for steps-array-only helpers point to the step-tree module.

## Implementation Notes
Keep utilities bounded in the same way existing traversal helpers are bounded. Do not move definition-order helpers that require flow/task definition knowledge.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local static tests assert the step-tree module exports the utilities and definition.js no longer exports those steps-array-only helpers.
